SYMPTOM: Admin panel 'VISOS ĮMONĖS' showed 'Nėra įmonių' even though orgs existed. No console errors.

CAUSE: fetchOrgs used client-side Supabase with the logged-in user's session. RLS on organizations table restricts reads to own org only. ned@tutlio.test has no org → query returns empty silently.

FIX: Updated AdminPanel.tsx to fetch orgs via GET /api/admin-org-features (uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, bypasses RLS). Also added PATCH support to admin-org-features.ts for suspension toggle.

PREVENT: All admin panel data fetches that need cross-org reads must use API routes with service role, never direct Supabase client in browser context.

FILES: src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx, api/admin-org-features.ts
